text:
nina: quick UX note from QA on embeddings export in rerank flow. two small but annoying things: SR reads the full preview table on open and the CTA just says "Export" which folks found confusing when there are multiple exports queued. attaching a screenshot.

rishi: yep saw that. keyboard users also hit the preview first sometimes and then it's a pain to get back to the confirm button. feels like focus order and aria exposure need a pass.

anita: a11y checklist suggestions:
- move initial focus to dialog heading (tabindex=-1 + focus()) so SR announces heading first
- set preview container aria-hidden=true until user expands it
- aria-live polite region for short summary: "Preview: 10 rows, ~120KB" when dialog opens
- give primary CTA an aria-label e.g. `aria-label="Start export of 10 vectors"`

claire: copy ideas: heading -> "Export 10 vectors"; CTA -> "Start export" (subtext: "Runs in background; we'll notify you"); preview toggle -> "Show export preview (10 rows, ~120KB)". Also default filename should include collection name and date, e.g. `collectionname-20260323-vectors.csv`.

product-bot: note: product requests default notify checkbox (checked) and retention copy: "Download link expires in 7 days." Track events: `export_started`, `preview_toggled`.

nina: action items I'll add to the ticket: focus heading, aria-hidden preview, aria-live summary, CTA aria-label + copy tweak, filename pattern, notify checkbox + retention copy, telemetry.
rishi: +1 I'll pick up the focus + aria-hidden work.
anita: +1, I'll write the a11y test cases for the ticket.
claire: +1, will update Figma frame with copy variants and the new filename pattern.
product-bot: staging: export-rerank-a11y branch built and deployed to staging at commit d4b2c1. please test keyboard and SR flows. :white_check_mark:
